t: Future-Proof Your Tech Career: The No Take-Back Guide to Winning in a World of Churn
s: This article explores the challenge of rapid technological change in tech careers, advocating for a focus on craft and core principles over fleeting trends to build obsolescence-resistant skills and find personal fulfillment (Ikigai) amidst industry churn.
sub: Adapting to technological churn vs. valuing craftsmanship
The 'content funnel' and ETL as obsolescence-resistant processes
Career implications of corporate acquisitions and feature dependence
Finding Ikigai through passion, skill, profession, and mission in tech
